_comment: Fixture for the shapes `wt-model litellm ... --json` (and its `wt litellm status --json` twin) prints. Read by wt/cmd/wt-model/litellm_test.go, wt/cmd/wt-model/litellm_sync_test.go, wt/cmd/wt-model/litellm_db_test.go and wt/cmd/wt-session/litellm_proxy_test.go. list rows carry store (file: a config.yaml row; db: a wt-managed row in LiteLLM's database, #598), and routed names both; sync_dry_run's plan carries move (routes the sync would move from config.yaml to the database), enable_db (it would write general_settings.store_model_in_db first) and restart (config.yaml would change, so the proxy would restart once). All three were added beside the older keys, whose meaning did not change.

warnings: failed to restart LiteLLM proxy (exit status 1); restart it manually: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/local.litellm.proxy
